decisions.decision: Track conditional approval, final approval, opening and operational authorization as separate states.
required_evidence: OCC final order or corporate decision

decisions.decision: Classify Ripple RNTB final approval as company-reported pending OCC final-order verification.
reason: Ripple announced final approval October 26 and described reserve-management/collateral-trustee authority
OCC decisions index still displays Conditional Approval 1359 and no later final order was located
OCC index says it updates as letters are ready, so absence is not disconfirmation

decisions.decision: Classify Circle National Trust as company-reported final approval to establish, with initial fiduciary custody and reserve management deferred to a future capability.
reason: Circle's July 10 announcement states custody upon opening and reserve management as future capability

decisions.decision: Classify Coinbase National Trust as OCC preliminary conditional approval only.
Do not treat OCC GENIUS Act final rule as effective on November 1 2026; effective date is January 18 2027.
Track OCC permitted-payment-stablecoin issuer application opening separately; as of November 1 OCC says it is not yet accepting applications pending OMB approval.
required_evidence: OMB approval and OCC opening announcement

feature_admission: none; regulatory statuses are event features only after point-in-time publication and operational-state verification
